lines.text: Hi, I'm Sindy! Welcome to the videos of {{title}}.
I'm a virtual presenter, and my voice is made by AI. In short videos like this one, I'll show your viewers around.
Every video takes four steps. You write the script and the scenes, voice the narration, check the result, and render it.
Your next episode is one command away. Run avatars new episode, and give it a name.
Fixture voice needs no speech model, so you can check it right away.
That's it for now. See you in the next video!
